faq.question: What does Adile mean?
faq.answer: Adile is associated with the Arabic form عَادِلَة, whose core sense is adile; just, fair (feminine).

faq.question: What is the origin of Adile?
faq.answer: Adile is associated with Arabic. Adile is the Turkish form of Arabic عَادِلَة (ʿĀdila), the feminine of عَادِل, meaning 'just, fair'.

faq.question: Is Adile an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form عَادِلَة is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Adile an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Adile can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Adile should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿĀdila is not a Quranic personal name.
